comparison.objective: Adjust threaded grip length and close an enclosure compression latch.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded adjustment followed by cam closure and sustained clamping.
comparison.success_condition: Sub-1 mm gap, clamp above 20 N, handle at least 175 degrees, stable for 20 seconds without contact.
comparison.reason: Tests adjustment and sustained latch compression, not impact fracture of insert tangs or recovery of released fragments.
